name: Terre de Femmes International Award
summary: A €10,000 grant for each of two nature projects led by a woman or a group of women, normally through a non-profit at least a year old, in any country. The theme changes each edition; the 2027 one is trees in cities: urban reforestation, native tree nurseries and restoring woodlands, parks and riverbanks.
reporting: Winners submit regular progress reports on their project.

steps: Online application on the Wiin platform

eligibility.rule: Led by a woman of legal age or a collective of women
Through a non-profit, or individually if national law prevents applying through one
The non-profit, if applying through one, was established at least 1 year ago
Project directly involves urban trees and has community or local ties
Not an urban mini-forest (such as Miyawaki) or a forest of non-native or non-diverse species
Not a carbon offset or timber-industry project
Won neither of the two previous editions

The Jury will meet once, no later than February 26, 2027, to select the winner.

eligibility.quote: Any woman of legal age or collective of women committed to nature conservation in connection with trees

through a non-profit organization (foundation, association, NGO ...) or on a personal basis, when the laws and regulations of their country prevent them from participating through a non-profit organization.
Through a non-profit organisation (association, NGO, foundation, etc.) established for at least 1 year
Projects with no direct connection to urban trees. - Isolated projects with no community or local ties.
Projects aimed at creating urban mini-forests (for example, using the Miyawaki method) or forests using non-native or non-diverse species.
Carbon offset initiatives or projects related to the timber industry.
Winners of the two (2) previous editions are not eligible for the International Award.
